en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, ornate early‑20th‑century institutional building in brick and stone along a broad street with tram tracks. The facade has three main storeys plus an attic, steep tiled roofs with dormers, and decorative gables at each end, featuring modest relief ornamentation. A high wall and metal fence with stone pillars separates the sidewalk and street from the building grounds. Young trees line the sidewalk, and there are no automobiles visible, only a very empty, orderly avenue.
